This will reveal whether the allocation was handed off to carrier ops and whether carrier acknowledged or rejected the pickup slots.

next_action.rationale: With root cause established (transient carrier feed lag on east-node pickup slots), the highest-information reversible mitigation is to correct the pickup slot windows for the affected carrier feed. This will allow the 186 orders' confirmations (which have now arrived after the original slot window closed) to match valid slots. Scope: east-node carrier feed slots only, reversible.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Slot correction will unblock the held orders by giving them valid pickup slots that overlap with their actual carrier confirmations. Post-correction, replay_held_allocations can be proposed to release them.

This information will enable a correctly-scoped second slot correction attempt.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Specific identification of the affected east-node carrier feed(s), confirmation that they are experiencing the 47-minute lag, and validation that re-correction to the correct feed(s) will resolve the held orders.
